files.rationale: Kept PR A's i18n code (translations, language init in initializeSettings, language-select listener, async DOMContentLoaded loading translations) together with PR B's chirp-on-done init, toggle listener (attached to the chirp input instead of weave's duplicated theme listener) and chirp-aware playNotificationSound, plus B's createActionButton changes, and removed weave's duplicated trailing block and second initializeSettings/DOMContentLoaded handlers.
The settings dialog keeps both new options: PR A's language selector and PR B's 'Chirp on done' toggle, placed after the dark-theme toggle.
